lines.text: After Israel enters the land, each animal offering comes with fine flour mixed with olive oil and wine as a drink offering.
A foreigner who wants to bring a food offering to the LORD must do exactly as the Israelites do.
Throughout their generations, the Israelites must lift up a cake from the first of their wine as a contribution.
When the whole congregation sins unintentionally, they bring one young bull and one male lamb, and the priest makes atonement.
The person who sins defiantly blasphemes the LORD and will be cut off from his people.
